name: INOVIQ Ltd
summary: INOVIQ Ltd specializes in the research, development, and commercialization of diagnostic and exosome-based products, aiming to improve the detection and treatment of cancer and other conditions across Australia and the United States. Its current portfolio includes the hTERT test, an immunocytochemistry assay that serves as a supplementary tool for urine cytology in bladder cancer screening, alongside EXO-NET, designed for the capture and isolation of exosomes from liquid biopsy specimens. The company also boasts a robust diagnostic pipeline, featuring blood tests currently under development for various cancers, including ovarian and breast cancer. Originally incorporated in 1983 and formerly known as BARD1 Life Sciences Limited until its rebranding to INOVIQ Ltd in December 2021, the company maintains its headquarters in Notting Hill, Australia.
